visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair in a blue t-shirt and a woman with dark hair tied in a bun wearing an olive green shirt sit on the floor. Between them is a low wooden coffee table holding a plate of blueberries and a plate of orange slices. The woman puts a slice of orange in her mouth while the man gestures with his hands open on his lap, looking perplexed and searching. The background shows a cozy, well-lit living room with a red sofa, yellow pillows, and a black piano. (2) The man leans forward, lifting the plate of blueberries with his left hand and the orange plate with his right hand to inspect the wooden table surface underneath them. The woman, watching him, points her finger down toward the center of the table. Suddenly, she reaches her right hand into the open air above the table, and a set of silver keys appears instantly in her grip as if by magic. (3) The woman holds the keys out to the man, who takes them with a stunned and confused expression, his mouth slightly agape. She then stands up abruptly, pointing her finger toward the table surface one last time with an emphatic gesture before walking out of the frame. The man remains seated for a moment, looking down at his empty hand and the keys in disbelief, then stands and exits the scene to the left.
